step1_analysis.description: A highly linear CMOS transconductor using a cross-coupled differential pair for active source degeneration. It converts the differential input voltage into two single-ended currents using wide-swing cascode PMOS current mirrors, serving as a front-end branch metric generator for a current-mode analog Viterbi decoder.

paper_reference.title: A 100-Mb/s 2.8-V CMOS Current-Mode Analog Viterbi Decoder

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the transconductor.

sky130_expected.calculation: 5 current branches (1x Iref, 2x tail, 2x output) * 50uA = 250uA. Power = 1.8V * 250uA = 450uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down from the full decoder power, assuming a nominal 50uA bias current per branch in SKY130 at 1.8V.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gm ≈ sqrt(2 * un*Cox * W/L * Id) for the main pair. With W/L=10, Id=50uA, un*Cox=270uA/V^2, Gm_main ≈ 520uS. The cross-coupling active degeneration reduces this slightly to improve linearity.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 NMOS parameters and a 50uA tail current.

linear_input_range.description: Differential input voltage range where Gm remains within 10% of its peak value.

sky130_expected.calculation: Cross-coupled active degeneration typically extends the linear range to roughly 2-3 times the overdrive voltage (Vov ≈ 0.2V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical performance of cross-coupled transconductors designed for wide linear range.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominant pole at PMOS mirror diode node. R ≈ 1/gm_p ≈ 4.5kOhm. C ≈ 2*Cgs_p ≈ 20fF. fp = 1/(2*pi*R*C) ≈ 1.7 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Estimated from parasitic capacitances of W=5u L=0.5u devices in SKY130. Easily supports the 100 Mb/s target.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, transconductance, linear input range, and AC bandwidth of the V-I converter.
step3_testbench.spice:
* V-I Converter Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm10a=5u L_xm10a=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm11a=5u L_xm11a=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm15a=5u L_xm15a=0.5u
.param W_xm14a=5u L_xm14a=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBIAS3 VBIAS3 0 0.99
Iref VDD N4 50u

Vcm Ncm 0 0.9
Vd Nd 0 dc 0 ac 1 sin(0 0.2 10Meg)
E1 VR_PLUS Ncm Nd 0 0.5
E2 Ncm VR_MINUS Nd 0 0.5

VoutL TO_ACSUS_L 0 0.9
VoutR TO_ACSUS_R 0 0.9

XM13 N1 VBIAS3 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM4 N8 VR_PLUS N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM9 N8 VBIAS3 N9 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM2 N2 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM5 N1 VR_MINUS N13 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM10A N6 N8 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10a} w={W_xm10a}
XM8 N9 N8 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM12 N3 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM11A TO_ACSUS_L VBIAS3 N6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11a} w={W_xm11a}
XM1 N4 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM3 N13 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM15A TO_ACSUS_R VBIAS3 N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm15a} w={W_xm15a}
XM14A N5 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14a} w={W_xm14a}
XM7 N2 VR_MINUS N13 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM6 N13 VR_PLUS N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * DC Sweep for Gm and Linearity
  dc Vd -0.5 0.5 0.01
  let idiff = i(VoutL) - i(VoutR)
  let gm = deriv(idiff)
  meas dc gm_max max gm
  meas dc gm_0 find gm at=0
  let gm_90 = gm_max * 0.9
  meas dc v_lin_pos when gm=gm_90 fall=1
  meas dc v_lin_neg when gm=gm_90 rise=1
  let linear_range = v_lin_pos - v_lin_neg
  print linear_range

  * AC Analysis for Bandwidth
  ac dec 20 1Meg 10G
  let idiff_ac = i(VoutL) - i(VoutR)
  let gm_ac = mag(idiff_ac)
  let gm_db = 20*log10(gm_ac)
  meas ac gm_dc find gm_ac at=1Meg
  let gm_db_dc = 20*log10(gm_dc)
  let gm_db_3db = gm_db_dc - 3
  meas ac bw_3db when gm_db=gm_db_3db fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 1n 200n
  let idiff_tran = i(VoutL) - i(VoutR)
  meas tran i_max max idiff_tran
  meas tran i_min min idiff_tran
  let i_swing = i_max - i_min
  print i_swing
  
  quit
.endc
.end
